The bass response stays nice and tight across the spectrum. Even at it's more extreme settings it remains focused and amp-like. The Magistrate delivers high-gain distortion with 18V internal headroom courtesy of a charge pump that converts standard 9V center-negative power. This increased voltage provides awesome headroom for such a high-gain pedal, keeping the tone focused and amp-like even at extreme settings. Full 3-band EQ (Treble, Bass, Mids) enables a wide range of tones from "Brown Sound" to full scooped-mid chunkiness. The bass response stays tight across the spectrum—no flubby low-end even when cranked. Responds remarkably well to your guitar's volume knob, cleaning up incredibly well so you can leave it on and just roll back for cleaner tones. Found in the rigs of Aerosmith, Baroness, and Slash. For players who need serious high-gain distortion with full tonal control and amp-like feel. True bypass switching.
